primarySources.finding: Random node generation sets the multicast marker to separate random identifiers from network-card addresses.
The earlier UUID specification prescribes the same separation using the first-octet multicast bit.

sourceFinding: Pinned setNodeInterface fallback calls randomBits on six bytes without setting the marker. randomBits uses io.ReadFull; the default reader is crypto/rand.Reader.
inference: This is a genuine conformance deviation. The exact reported attacker/impact does not demonstrate a practical collision or extra capability under the declared security scope. A concrete weak-entropy generator or shipped exploitable consumer would require its own evidence.
judgment: false for the exact security report, not denial of the missing marker
limitation: Codex source judgment; maintainers may disagree on classifying an integrity-relevant standards deviation without a concrete exploit. No collision experiment is claimed for this report.
